text: Olá, desculpa, maybe this is a silly question. Minha filha, 10 years, has been saying her ear hurts all evening and she keeps pulling at it, coitadinha. Temperature is 38.7. Her colour is normal, lips normal, she looks like herself. I gave her nothing yet because I wasn't sure. Do I just give paracetamol and wait for the GP amanhã or is that not enough?
